data.title: 贝塔 · 浅滩波光间的羞怯相邀
data.description: 阳光明媚的海滨白沙滩上，浪花漫过脚背。贝塔双手轻按在粉白荷叶边泳装前，双颊飞起微红的羞涩，回眸看向走来的暗影大人，既期待被注视又手足无措。
data.location: sun-drenched tropical white sand beach with turquoise waves lapping the shore
data.action: standing in shallow crystal-clear sea foam, hands nervously hovering near chest, looking over shoulder with blushing cheeks and flustered sparkling eyes
data.lighting: bright clear morning sunlight casting brilliant azure reflections across gentle sea waves
data.mood: innocent bashfulness, secret romantic yearning, playful summer charm
data.promptProse: Beta stands in turquoise shallow sea waves on a white sandy beach, blushing shyly with hands near her chest as ocean foam splashes around her ankles.
data.animaCaption: Beta blushing in shallow coastal waves in her ruffled pink bikini.
